title: Migrate the nit Workspace to v2 Artifacts

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the migrated workspace, When `nit:tasks` runs its Step 0 validation for PHASE-4, Then every precondition it checks is satisfied — `phase.json`, `prd/summary.json`, `boundaries/modules.json`, and `registry/task-types.json` all exist and validate.
Given every generated `phase.json` and `task.json`, When each is validated against its schema, Then all pass, and each task's acceptance criteria match the prose it came from in count and in text.

Given `boundaries/modules.json`, When `nit route` resolves routing for a task, Then it exits 0 rather than failing with "Module registry not found", so the skill composition engine works on this repository.
Given the migrated task files, When their declared modules and types are inspected, Then every `targetModule` names a module in the registry and every `type` is one of the four the schema allows.
Given the v1 prose files, When the migration completes, Then they are still present and unmodified, and nothing claims a task ran through the supervisor when it did not.
